Dangerous Goods

दबाव पात्र

A container designed to hold gases or liquids at pressures substantially different from ambient pressure, regulated for transport under UN and IMDG codes.

Quick answer: A container designed to hold gases or liquids at pressures substantially different from ambient pressure, regulated for transport under UN and IMDG codes.

Why it matters

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

A container designed to hold gases or liquids at pressures substantially different from ambient pressure, regulated for transport under UN and IMDG codes.

Operational example

Pressure vessels must be certified and marked according to the relevant UN standards before international shipping.
